product_wide_rationale: It carries the goals Appendix A conflict rules and the authority to change Product law, which bind every child Domain and every law record, so no single child Domain can own it.
summary: One validated contract table holds every goals Appendix A rule with its enforcing mechanism or a listed gap, and applying a rule leaves a record. An agent changes law that is not serious under P12 with a recorded reason, and that revision makes the record derived; serious changes, crucial-size changes, and governed scope cuts keep operator approval. Operator approval points fall in four classes or stay as listed gaps. Follow-up items carry a rule label in Linear.
title: The conflict rules are one checked table, and an agent changes law that is not serious
